statement_map.email_excerpt: we are sorry for the trouble this has caused
Some of your students told you that the lesson videos in your course keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones.
We opened the lesson link you shared on a desktop in Chrome, in Safari and on a phone.
The video played fine each time, so we could not reproduce the problem.
Ask one of your students to make a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.
We will raise this with our team and get back to you.
We are not able to give a timeline yet.
